WITH player_match_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        pm.player_id,
        pm.match_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) AS total_runs_in_match
    FROM player_match pm
    LEFT JOIN ball_by_ball bb 
        ON pm.match_id = bb.match_id
        AND pm.player_id = bb.striker
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs 
        ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY pm.player_id, pm.match_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_matches,
       SUM(CASE WHEN total_runs_in_match = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matches_with_zero_runs
FROM player_match_runs
WHERE player_id = 40;

function.arguments:
{"sql": "
-- Step 1: For each player, calculate their average runs per match across all matches they played
-- A player's "runs per match" = total runs scored in all matches / number of matches played

WITH player_match_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        pm.player_id,
        pm.match_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) AS total_runs_in_match
    FROM player_match pm
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs 
        ON pm.match_id = bs.match_id
    GROUP BY pm.player_id, pm.match_id
),
player_avg_runs_per_match AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        SUM(total_runs_in_match) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(match_id) AS matches_played,
        CASE 
            WHEN COUNT(match_id) > 0 THEN SUM(total_runs_in_match) * 1.0 / COUNT(match_id)
            ELSE 0 
        END AS avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_match_runs
    GROUP BY player_id
),
country_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        p.country_name,
        AVG(parm.avg_runs_per_match) AS country_batting_avg
    FROM player_avg_runs_per_match parm
    JOIN player p ON parm.player_id = p.player_id
    GROUP BY p.country_name
)
SELECT 
    country_name,
    ROUND(country_batting_avg, 2) AS country_batting_avg
FROM country_avg
ORDER BY country_batting_avg DESC
LIMIT 5;
", "preview_rows": 10}

WITH player_match_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        pm.player_id,
        pm.match_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) AS total_runs_in_match
    FROM player_match pm
    LEFT JOIN ball_by_ball bb 
        ON pm.match_id = bb.match_id
        AND pm.player_id = bb.striker
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs 
        ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY pm.player_id, pm.match_id
),
player_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        SUM(total_runs_in_match) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(match_id) AS matches_played,
        SUM(total_runs_in_match) * 1.0 / COUNT(match_id) AS avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_match_runs
    GROUP BY player_id
)
SELECT player_id, total_runs, matches_played, avg_runs_per_match
FROM player_avg
WHERE player_id = 40;
